name: Material Wealth
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in material wealth, emphasizing that reliance on riches leads to downfall, while righteousness leads to flourishing. Believers are instructed not to store up earthly treasures subject to decay and theft, but to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, promising that their needs will be met. The Bible also cautions against covetousness, reminding us that life is not measured by possessions, and encourages contentment grounded in God's faithful presence rather than in material abundance. Serving God and wealth are mutually exclusive, underscoring the call to prioritize devotion to God above all.
